component.name: Chaos Maker
component.summary: Record, arrange and mix music with instruments, MIDI and guitar effects

description.p: A multitrack digital audio workstation with its own instruments and effects.

ul.li: Record audio tracks and arrange clips on the timeline
Piano roll for MIDI, an on-screen piano and the computer keyboard as a keyboard
Drum kit, electronic drums, grand piano, harmonium, synth and bass guitar
A guitar pedalboard with a tuner, amp and cabinet
Mixer, equalizers and mix effects on every track
Export the song as WAV or MP3

description.p: Needs JACK (or PipeWire's JACK support) and a 64-bit processor with AVX2.
